newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco raised to buy.

text.p: -- Grupo Financiero Serfin raised Mexican cement firm Apasco to buy from hold, and set a price target of 84.5 pesos by December 1997, or a return of 59 percent.

-- "Sales of cement and concrete are expected to grow by the same proportion as GDP in the formal construction sector, which should be between 10 and 12 percent for 1997," Serfin analyst Gerardo Saenz wrote in a report.
-- He noted that Apasco recouped market share in the last quarter of 1996 by cutting cement prices. He also said it was positive that it would raise prices in early 1997.
-- He raised his earnings per share estimates for 1996 to 3.61 pesos from 3.35 pesos. For 1997, he bolstered his projection to 3.60 pesos from 3.48 pesos.
